The actual WF-C6-010 migration preflight proves the runtime database identity and write recipient, but leaves one BYPASSRLS SELECT recipient unattributed. This supplemental catalog observer compares that recipient with the declared role in stable protected canonical backup.env, through the existing held runtime and migration connections. It exports finite identity/profile/default-setting/membership counts without role names, credentials or business rows. READ_COMPLETE is evidence only and never ACL approval.

Original fourteen inspector paths and five baseline/gate paths remain byte unchanged. No backup password file/third connection/service/dump, production grant/configuration/file mutation, activation or personnel automation. Configured identity does not prove fresh backup authentication, commissioning, operation or restore.

Exact head60efe23846fddc7deea16c48ba3a90bd962aae35/treee57592a08b458c5bfd815029d93fa6a7ae1969b1 has independent cross-review: peer reviews root helper; root reviews peer SQL/tests/workflow. Fixed counter-coherence finding retained. Local Node20 13unitPASS/1mandatoryhostedPG SKIP, runner50 and diffcheckPASS; full checks NOT RUN on Contabo. Hosted source job must run unchanged old52 plus new14, including the actual default production helper transport, real PostgreSQL positive/negative/cleanup. Five full required checks and own normal exact-SHA release remain pending before protected main-bound read-only dispatch.
